conditions.with_cache: Static instructions (prompt + handbook), byte-identical on every model call, with a stable prompt_cache_key 'campus-customs-vendor-desk-v1'.
conditions.without_cache: Same prompt and handbook, but a unique prompt_cache_key per run and a fresh one-line nonce at the very start of the instruction prefix on every model call, so no prefix can match a cached prefix.

validation.rule: A without_cache model call counts only if the API reports cache_read_tokens == 0.
